_documentation.purpose: Longer, slower two-temperature TDGL optical vortex search; each trial is computationally expensive.
_documentation.authority: Values in this file are authoritative for its runner. A sweep value overrides the corresponding base-simulation value only for that named case; effective values are recorded in summary.json.

fields.simulation_config: Base production simulation JSON built before this runner applies documented experiment controls.
fields.initial_vortex.x_fraction: Initial x divided by film width; 0.505 seeds between mesh nodes for unambiguous winding detection.
fields.initial_vortex.y_fraction: Initial y divided by film height; 0.505 seeds between mesh nodes for unambiguous winding detection.
fields.initial_vortex.charge: Integer vortex winding: +1 is a vortex and -1 an antivortex.
fields.initial_vortex.core_radius_cells: Initial vortex-core radius measured in mesh cells.
fields.path.start_m: Beam starting point in metres, aligned with the seeded vortex.
fields.path.direction: Unit travel direction; reverse control travels in its negative direction.
fields.path.distance_m: How far the beam moves during transport, in metres.
fields.path.initial_hold_s: Stationary illumination time before beam motion, in seconds.
fields.path.final_hold_s: Stationary illumination time after beam motion, in seconds.
fields.search.magnetic_fields_T: Applied perpendicular field values to test, in tesla.
fields.search.laser_powers_W: Absorbed optical powers to test, in watts; not incident laser power.
fields.search.laser_speeds_m_s: Beam path speeds to test, in metres per second.
fields.search.spot_sigma_m: Gaussian optical-heating standard deviation in metres.
fields.search.sample_every: Save diagnostics every this many accepted steps.
fields.search.vortex_amplitude_floor: Minimum corner order-parameter amplitude used to count a winding.
fields.search.max_track_step_cells: Maximum vortex jump between saved frames, in grid cells.
fields.search.maximum_steps_per_trial: Hard cap on coupled time steps per candidate to bound runtime.
fields.search.maximum_trials: Number of distinct field, power, speed combinations to inspect.
fields.search.sampling_seed: Random seed for reproducible ordering of the full parameter grid.
fields.search.stop_at_first_correlation: Stop once a candidate passes motion and all three controls.
fields.thresholds.minimum_beam_displacement_m: Sets minimum beam displacement m; units are metres.
fields.thresholds.minimum_vortex_displacement_m: Sets minimum vortex displacement m; units are metres.
fields.thresholds.minimum_position_correlation: Required Pearson correlation of beam and vortex displacement along the path.
fields.thresholds.maximum_rms_lag_m: Largest allowed RMS separation of vortex and beam throughout transport, in metres.
fields.thresholds.maximum_initial_offset_m: Largest accepted mismatch between initial vortex and beam coordinates, in metres.
fields.thresholds.minimum_control_difference_m: Moving-beam displacement must exceed no-laser and stationary-beam drift by this distance.
fields.magnetic_field.gauge: Vector-potential gauge used to represent the applied magnetic field.
fields.output_directory: Base output directory; runners reserve a numbered sibling if it already exists.
